MINOR MAINTENANCE TIPS

Wait for a few minutes and clean the chain thoroughly
from any dirt, grime, etc.

Rotate rear wheel slowly and simultaneously apply rec-
ommended chain lubricant on the chain links.


ENGINE OIL LEVEL CHECKING

Place the vehicle on a level surface upright.

Start the engine from cold condition, allow the engine
to idle for 2 to 3 minutes and stop the engine.

Wait 2 to 3 minutes to settle the oil and assess the sight
glass. The volume added the minimum to maximum
level is approximately 350 ml.

Engine oil level should be close to “MAX” condition.

If in case of oil level is not in above mentioned condi-
tion, then top-up the oil to “MAX” condition and repeat
the procedure.

Do not over ﬁll above the “MAX” mark as it may aﬀect
the clutch function.
